q: How do I calculate emissions from curing tobacco in flue-cured barns?
title: Flue-cured tobacco barn emissions
short: Weigh the coal or firewood burned per barn season and divide by kilograms of cured leaf. Coal CO2 is fossil and counts fully; firewood CO2 is biogenic and reported separately. Fuel per kilogram varies widely with barn insulation and furnace design.
audience: Tobacco growers, leaf companies and their buyers

ul: Coal tonnes or firewood kilograms per barn.
Green leaf loaded and cured leaf out.
Number of curings in the season.

p: Insulated barns and better furnaces cut fuel per kilogram, and the per-kg figure shows the gain.

example.title: One barn season
lines: Coal CO2 from tonnes x NCV x the IPCC factor, then divided by 3,000 kg
